name: translate-text
description: Translate user-provided text into a target language, preserving tone.
steps: detect the source language of the input
route via privacy policy: secret content stays on local models
return the translation plus any untranslatable terms flagged
validation: output language matches the requested target
failure_recovery: return a literal gloss with uncertain parts marked
cautions: never send secret-scope text to cloud models for translation
read-only: never writes translations into files unless asked
